website.name: Invisible City Tours
website.executive_summary:
Invisible City Tours is a guide-led Sintra experience brand. Phase-1 site is brochure + lead capture. Copy should be clear English, euro pricing, no platform chrome, and a consistent fact → interpretation → suggestion → final workflow.

Priority: global footer/chrome, home hero, pricing labels, contact, then tour pages.

pages.name: Home
pages.analysis_html: Strong brand idea (story-led Sintra + Goodfoot) undermined by ALL CAPS, typos, duplicate lines, and Odoo footer chrome.
pages.guidelines_html: Sentence case; one EN voice; € before amount; CTAs = View tours / WhatsApp; remove Odoo free website.
